mechanics.claim: Basic attacks consume one Medarda Maxim stack each to become empowered, dealing bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks consume one {{tip|stack}} each to become empowered.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup, meaning it cannot be cancelled once started, which affects attack timing.
Stacks are consumed on-hit, so applying on-hit effects without an attack (e.g. Guinsoo's Rageblade) consumes a stack without dealing the bonus damage or restoring energy.
mechanics.quote: Stacks of ''Medarda Maxim'' are consumed {{tip|on-hit}}, so means of applying on-hit effects without attacking (eg. {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}) will consume them without dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} or restoring {{as|energy}}.

mechanics.claim: A stack of Medarda Maxim is generated after the lockout of each ability cast, refreshing the 4-second duration and stacking up to 3 times.
mechanics.quote: she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Medarda Maxim'' after the ability's respective lockout for 4 seconds, refreshing with subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times
